notes.title: DEV UPDATE #7
notes.notes:
Greetings, Operators,

In Dev Update 7, you’ll see some of the things we’ve worked on between May 2025 and September 2025.



One of the highlight of our recent work in terms of audio is the creation of an in-house audio system allowing us to support verticality and dynamic reverberation based on room size and material. We now have an interfaces with a custom MetaSound node that imitates sound passing through floors above/below. A new creature SFX designer recently joined us and is now is making our anomalies sounds far more terrifying.



For animations, we’ve fully replaced the placeholder third-person animations (the game isn’t third-person, but other players see 3P animations). These are now much more detailed and better reflect player input. You’ll also see the F2000 animation set, some AS-VAL clips, and the revive-syringe animation.



Psychoghost also showcases the new PVE anomaly model (Big Boy), 30 minutes of character customization sped up to a 2 minute clips, some PvP clips, and more! If you want to see it all in action and hear more details, check out the full video. We’re excited to show you what’s next.

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #6
notes.notes:
Greetings, Operators,
In Dev Update 6, you’ll see some of the things we’ve worked on between January 2025 and May 2025.

First up, a lot of you noticed in some precedent leaks a big spider on the walls of our dev test map. This is a new AI monster in the work, a terrifying spider-women-like anomaly that is meant to scare you when you least expect it. She doesn't have a proper name yet but we're still reviewing the suggestions you've made on our on Discord!

On the weapon side, we've been working on integrating several new guns such as the mosing, SKS, APS, MP5 and SG533, and we've made the model for the AS VAL. Our weapon pool is starting to be quite diverse, and gunplay now feels varied enough to offer plenty of ways to approach combat against other players. We still need to implement bolt cycling, shotgun pump action and scopes, that's something we want to do very soon.

We’re also working on a melee system—starting with a knife, which you can see in action with its new animations in the video below. 3D assets of medical items are now done, the animation phase will be next. Some environement reworks on our first map Ground Zero...

But that's not all :
If you want to see it all in action and hear more details, check out the full video. We’re excited to show you what’s next.

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #4
notes.notes:
Greetings, Operators,
In Dev Update 4, you’ll see some of the things we’ve worked on between July and October.

One of the highlights is the introduction of the PDA, the Personal Digital Assistant. This device on the forearm of the player will be the main source of information. You'll be able to access details related to the game mode, friends, your health status, world events, and navigation around the map. The Sheitan, a new PvE anomaly designed to surprise players, is now in its animation phase and will soon be implemented in the game. We’ve also refined gun animations and introduced point aiming, a middle ground between hipfire and ADS.

Check out the full details in the video below!

notes.title: DEV UPDATE #1
notes.notes:
Greetings operators.
Today we want to share with you what we have been working on recently and what we will be working on in the coming weeks and months.

Dev Update presented by Psychoghost
[previewyoutube=1sQHgAfRE84;full][/previewyoutube]
In this dev update, Psychoghost present you the new customization tab, new weapon attachments and animations, rework of the juggernaut, grenade vfx, exfil points and our early work on the new map.

Previous video :
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dI795yNHLZU
In this video : New AI monster, factions, teleportation, chem lights and Mk18 weapon animations.

400 000 wishlists
We have surpassed 400k wishlists! 
We're really thankful for your solid support every day. Now road to 500k !

2023 rewind
2023 is behind us, and we'd like to do quick rewind of the most important moments of last year.


 January - Creation of Deep Worlds / lots of new people joining the project
 February - Moving to Geneva
 March - Setting up the studio
 April - The month that changed everything for us thanks to the videos by Player2 and then Bigfry 
 May - 50k wishlists / 3k Discord members / Playtests with the first iteration of the gameloop
 June - Decision to add AI anomalies to the game / Video from Operator Drewski (2M views) / 100k wishlists / 6k Discord members
 July - Playtests / Changing light system to lumen
 August - Vacations for some people in the team / Hard work for others / trailer finalized with north studio
 September - Reveal of our CGI trailer (more than 2M cumulated views atm) / 150k wishlists / 10k Discord members
 October - Huge changes to Ground Zero raid gameloop / Playtests / CC program / 200k wishlists / 12k Discord members
 November - Working on big playtest Patch with refined gameloop
 December - Playtests dedicated to content creators and many videos published.
